summary: The registrant, GAMCO Natural Resources, Gold & Income Trust (GNT), filed an 8-K under Items 1.01 and 8.01 to disclose entry into a Sales Agreement with G.research, LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to 1,000,000 common shares. Terms include a minimum sale price of net asset value per share plus commission. The offering is under an existing shelf registration statement on Form N-2. This is a routine capital-raising activity via an ATM program, not a special situation. Legal opinion from Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP is provided. No special situation categorization applies.
